analyst.summary: Kalpataru Projects International is one of India's largest power-transmission EPC contractors, now well diversified internationally and into other infrastructure verticals. Both revenue and profit grew strongly this year, and the order book -- at more than double annual revenue -- gives unusually good visibility into future work. The balance sheet carries the typical working-capital intensity of large contractors, which is a normal feature of the business rather than a new risk. We rate this a Hold: strong execution and a well-stocked order book, but the valuation already reflects much of that strength.
